title: SubscribePremiumResult
description: Phase 4: result of SubscribePremiumActivity.subscribePremium. status=FAILED is returned (not thrown) so the workflow can audit and proceed without trail.

subscription_id.description: Opaque ID for the active subscription. Empty string when status=FAILED.

subscribed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the subscription was created (or attempted).

status.description: Outcome. FAILED returns instead of throwing so the workflow can audit and continue.
